web-guide-idea-37.audience: Students and professionals preparing a specific presentation.
web-guide-idea-37.offer: Offer a rehearsal where the speaker can practise aloud and receive usable feedback. The outcome is a clearer delivery plan.
web-guide-idea-37.steps.0: Ask for the audience and time limit.
web-guide-idea-37.steps.1: Listen to a timed rehearsal and note where meaning gets lost.
web-guide-idea-37.steps.2: Practise the opening, transitions and ending again.
web-guide-idea-37.equipment: A camera phone, quiet room and timer. The speaker may need their slides on another screen.
web-guide-idea-37.returnReason: Return sessions can target questions, confidence or a revised pitch as the event approaches.
web-guide-idea-37.promotion: Share one practical presentation tip and explain the rehearsal format and time limit.
